trial.name: Water for Both Banks

Cindercup108 takes warmth from the dry plate and releases into the marked seam using one same-owner token; the vent must remain open.
Talusnip110 seats the stone stop from its marked side without occupying the walking lane.
Hingelet102 quiets the oscillating west pin; Rillkite104 then deposits the side wake into the east runnel. Each station has its own exact cast proof.

Walk the two dry observation shelves, read both level marks, and confirm at the steward. Five phases are serial, with local sanctuary reassignment available between completed stations. At least two intentional Yang/Yin switches occur; no five-member party is required.

trial.name: The Last Watch
trial.mechanic: A shelter defense with spatial repair, not a legendary boss arena
steps: A rest group chooses the open center of the refuge. Read three clear marks: vent, brace and quiet hinge.
Manually open the vent; Cindercup108 carries warmth between the adjacent plate and seam in one fresh cast.
Talusnip110 seats the refuge brace from its outside; Hingelet102 quiets the door pin. These can be done in either order.

Start three short squall waves only by explicit interaction. At most3 ordinary enemies and3 projectiles appear; each wave lasts up to180 active updates and starts only after the last is cleared with the existing weapon. No auto-running timer between waves.

During each wave a different marked shutter loosens. Pause in the safe alcove, reset that shutter by hand and defend the visible approach. Residents remain safe and refuse to move while an approach is blocked.
After the final quiet interval, return to the open center and invite the residents to take turns keeping watch.

common_rules.stats_are: Original catalog weights totaling330; do not silently turn them into owner-derived damage bonuses. Current combat uses authored damage/phase resolver. Distinct value comes from tactical command shape and outcomes.
common_rules.party_limit: One legendary in the entire four-member party, as current creatures_party_validate already enforces. Any of the eight can remain in storage; collecting all does not require placing all in party.
common_rules.combat: Respect global effect/equipment locks, unchanged equipment clamps and remaining cooldown across cancel/recast/party swap. Effects cannot overlap to evade their own cap. Proposed numbers require actual combat review.
common_rules.acquisition: One deterministic source each. Trial completion, quest reward claim and optional recruitment are three different operations. No trading, external clock, RNG, payment, unique consumables or required optional evolution.
common_rules.language: English designer copy only; review original Japanese localization and native glyph clipping before enabling.
common_rules.art: Eight independently drawn16x16 native field silhouettes, four directions/four walk frames per direction and original cast sequences/portraits. Existing modes may need art offsets, not enlarged collision or OAM budgets. Distinction at grayscale/native size must be demonstrated, not assumed.
